correctness.rationale: For nondecreasing maps f satisfying f³=f², each f²-fiber is a rooted contiguous interval preserved by f. A one-sided basin of length L has 2^(L-1) possibilities for L>=1, giving B(z)=z(1-z)²/(1-2z)². Idempotent basin E(z)=z/(1-z)². Ordered basin concatenation gives strict bivariate GF (1-uB)^-1-(1-uE)^-1, with specified n=0 convention. Unique positive dominant simple pole rho≈.3079785 and exponentially smaller idempotent pole, standard analytic quasi-powers gives Gaussian fixed-point CLT with mu≈.3014166, variance≈.1935077. Independent brute nondecreasing-map enumeration through n=7 reproduced totals 0,0,2,12,53,208,768 and GF coefficients.
